summary: The sheet provides wall sections and structural notes for a McDonald's site in Washington, DC. It contains detailed drawing of wall sections, connections, and various structural notes related to steel, wood, and concrete.

published.title: Unspecified Design Load Criteria
published.observation: The design criteria notes specify various loads like floor live load, roof live load, special roof loads, etc., but do not explicitly mention the wind load or seismic load criteria.
published.drawing_evidence: Design Criteria note section listing various loads without mention of wind or seismic loads.
published.drawing_location: Top right section under Design Criteria notes
published.recommendation: Confirm the wind and seismic design criteria according to the 2015 IBC and local amendments.

published.title: Inconsistent Connection Labeling
published.observation: Connection 1 and Connection 2 labels are reused in both wall sections without clear distinction of which detail they apply to.
published.drawing_evidence: Connection labels applied to different structural components without differentiation.
published.drawing_location: Wall sections, left and middle of the sheet
published.recommendation: Clarify connection labels to ensure accurate interpretation of structural details.

published.title: Requirement for Concrete Caps
published.observation: Notes indicate the requirement to provide concrete caps at all steel column pockets.
published.drawing_evidence: "Provide concrete caps at all steel column pockets" note under Structural Notes.
published.drawing_location: Bottom right, under Reinforced Concrete notes
published.recommendation: Ensure that this requirement is communicated to contractors and integrated into the construction process.
